text: Given a Recorder stub for POST scripts/run, When immybot_scripts_run_adhoc(computerId=7, content="Write-Output 'hi'", confirm=true) is called, Then the outbound request has body/computerId/cancellationId at the top level (no script key), body.action equals the given content, and the tool returns done: true with the recorder's stubbed output.

Given a script longer than 200 characters, When immybot_scripts_run_adhoc is called with confirm omitted, Then no request reaches scripts/run, and the preview's excerpt is the first 200 characters of the content followed by '...'.
Given a script that is exactly 200 characters, When immybot_scripts_run_adhoc is called with confirm omitted, Then the preview's excerpt is the full content verbatim, with no '...' appended.
Given language="CommandLine", When immybot_scripts_run_adhoc is called confirmed, Then the outbound request's body.scriptLanguage is "CommandLine".
Given any confirmed call, When the outbound request is inspected, Then it has no top-level script key, and cancellationId parses as a valid UUID.
Given empty script content, When immybot_scripts_run_adhoc is called with confirm=true, Then no request reaches scripts/run and the call does not succeed as if it ran.

Given no optional parameters are supplied, When immybot_scripts_run_adhoc is called confirmed, Then the outbound request has outputType="Object", scriptExecutionContext="System", timeout=30, parameterOverrides={}, and name="Ad hoc script (MCP)".

Given name, outputType="Table", timeout=60, runAs="User", parameters={"A": 1} are all supplied, When immybot_scripts_run_adhoc is called confirmed, Then the outbound request reflects every one of those values, including scriptExecutionContext="CurrentUser".

Given a preview call followed by a confirmed call with distinctive script content, When all emitted log records across both calls are inspected, Then the script's full text never appears in any of them.

Given a real ImmyBot instance and computer, When an agent calls immybot_scripts_run_adhoc with a Ginko-style "download ScriptURL then iex" PowerShell body and confirm=true, Then it executes successfully with no HTTP 400 and the output is returned.
steps: Obtain credentials for a live ImmyBot instance and an online computer id on it
Call immybot_scripts_run_adhoc with content equal to a short, safe PowerShell probe script, computerId=<id>, confirm=true
Inspect the HTTP response / tool result
expect: No HTTP 400 for a missing/unexpected body field or an invalid cancellationId; result contains done: true and the script's actual output
evidence: needs a real vendor account (mcp-track.md 2.5/3): DEV01 has no live ImmyBot credentials in this environment; does not block 6b per mcp-track.md 3 completion criteria

text: Given script content containing single quotes, backticks and embedded newlines, When immybot_scripts_run_adhoc is called confirmed, Then the outbound request's body.action contains that content unmangled (exact string equality).
